description: Capability tiering for trust and permission prompts.

tiers.tier1_moderate: spawn props, room/profile edits, persistence writes
tiers.tier2_high: save-affecting, wasm write actions, world authoring

assets.raw.v1.description: Declares raw loose assets via assetSourceDefinitions and exposes prepared host paths for the owning mod only.

render.meshes.v1.description: Registers reusable render meshes backed by modelAsset/modelDisplayList so mods can draw external visuals in-world.

render.skeletons.v1.description: Reserved contract for external skeleton definitions bound by convention-first v3 packages.

render.animations.v1.description: Reserved contract for external animation clip definitions bound by convention-first v3 packages.

render.animation_graphs.v1.description: Reserved contract for animation graph/state machine definitions under the v3 graph DSL.

actors.prefabs.v1.description: Registers visual prefabs that bind transforms and LOD behavior to render meshes for actor/world placement.

world.instances.v1.description: Places prefab-backed world instances by scene and optional room filters from JSON.

world.triggers.v1.description: Reserved contract for trigger volumes loaded from the world DSL.

world.encounters.v1.description: Reserved contract for encounter/spawn orchestration loaded from the world DSL.

audio.events.v1.description: Reserved contract for audio event definitions authored from JSON.

cutscenes.tracks.v1.description: Reserved contract for cutscene track definitions authored from JSON.

editor.placement.v1.description: Registers reusable placeable entries that point at prefab visuals and provide default scene/room/transform hints.

world.authoring.v1.description: Places authored world visuals using direct prefab references or editor placement library entries.

dsl.components.v1.description: Loads generic component DSL documents from the components/ convention root.

dsl.entities.v1.description: Loads generic entity DSL documents from the entities/ convention root.

dsl.graphs.v1.description: Loads generic graph/state machine DSL documents from the graphs/ convention root.

services.endpoints.v1.description: Declares service endpoint metadata for cross-mod read/query surfaces consumed through the shared WASM/native host service bus.

native.sdk.v1.description: Stable native C ABI plugin surface loaded from runtime.entryLibrary.

native.raw_cpp.v1.description: Build-coupled raw engine interop for native plugins; requires explicit raw grant.

rules: Capabilities must be declared before use.
Denied capability calls must produce no side-effects.
Tier2+ defaults to deny until explicit user grant.
assets.raw.v1 requires assetSourceDefinitions and is limited to files owned by the declaring mod package.
render.meshes.v1 requires meshDefinitions and supports .obj, .otr/.o2r, or Fast64 source folders through the existing model loader.
render.skeletons.v1, render.animations.v1 and render.animation_graphs.v1 are contract entries for the convention-first v3 pipeline and currently load as metadata/DSL surfaces.
actors.prefabs.v1 requires prefabDefinitions and references render.meshes.v1 entries.
world.instances.v1 requires worldInstanceDefinitions and references actors.prefabs.v1 entries.
world.triggers.v1, world.encounters.v1, audio.events.v1 and cutscenes.tracks.v1 are convention-first world DSL surfaces.
editor.placement.v1 requires editorPlacementDefinitions and references actors.prefabs.v1 entries.
world.authoring.v1 requires worldAuthoringDefinitions and can reference editor.placement.v1 or actors.prefabs.v1 entries.
dsl.components.v1, dsl.entities.v1 and dsl.graphs.v1 load generic JSON DSL documents from their convention roots.
services.endpoints.v1 declares public service metadata and uses sharePolicy for access rules across the shared WASM/native host service bus.
native.sdk.v1 requires runtime.type=native-cpp-v1|hybrid-v1 and permission nativeinterop.
native.raw_cpp.v1 requires runtime.nativeMode=raw and permissions nativeinterop + nativeinterop.raw.
